book.title: Lakbogogi Wene Lukas en Lakbogogi Wene dirup watigi yi aro

content: Agiripa ivaga yugeragagi wene

Yugirigya lagagimu, at Agiripa en Paulus yugugu dugwit, “Hat ogagagin ako iru,” yiluk, yugugu lagagimu, Paulus agap wendak-hedagiluk wene adem sigam erogo avyarat yugeragiluk, inggi-vaga en, “Mbauk dogones,” yugirigya lagagirik,
“Ai, nasin Raja
Agiripa wa. It Yakuri en, 'Yerogo ogagagi, nderogo ogagagi,' novaga belagwi andi, o yogak hat hivaga vagalogo yukhirisogon andi, nendawi adenggen agirik o.
Nit Yakuri ogasagwi menda inim, wene ngga menda yidibaluk yagalagwi inim, hat ovok helup atma, yegek lagya neyagek, 'Hanggon,' nombarubuk, nasin.”
“O muk avyak maduk nawi adem vaga dugwit, ogarit lagya, andi okbaluk, o Yerusalem dugwit ogagya, ogagya lagagis ako, it Yakuri menda ovok enelup aro.

Nit Yakuri wene yugup wokbaluk ogasagwi menda andi, it nin enane anye vaga yagan nagu lagagwa Parisi menda ako, an ogo it ninim yagan lagya lagagis ako, o muk en enelupma, vagalogo yukheraup embetao halok andi, yukheramwak.”
“Eke, yogak Ala en nenasini avyarat nggatuk erogo yugeragagi ako
wene nape wenggelek agirik andi vaga woknombolok nawene diluguluk, bani wagao inigis.

Avyarat nggatuk erogo yugeragagi ako nit Yakup aburi nininis unggul 12 suku ako en, ‘Atma arisogon, ai!’ yiluk, umbutu dugwit, o hup-dingga, nenendawi eve vaga, Ala siyabelagwi. An ogo wene andi, nape wenggelek agirik andi vaga it Yakuri en naruguluk, wene novaga bagaoma, nasin!
Anderogoma, hit nggarogo yiluk At Ala en avakwa hambisagwima en iniluk erogo mondok okbisaup andi meyan ombasagwi?”
“Eke an ogo endak At Yesus Nasaret menda andi, inis wiyiknom-weyaknom erogo bayogon imbitya lagagirik,

o Yerusalem dugwit, anderogo ogagya lagagis. Ogagya dugwit, it ap imam-imam enasini ako en yuknogogwa vaga it Ala aburi adik denek eneyave wisane heda marogo lembaga mabisa lagya, eke, 'Enarup a, dek a?' yugu-selok, anen, 'Enarup aro,' yugirigya, ogagya lagagis.

It Yakuri samban ogasagwima dombok edup-mbedup okbugu, eke, 'At Yesus inis wiyiknom-weyaknom erogo bas o,' yiluk, nane anye vaga yugirigya, ogagya lagagis. It avyarat ombasagwi andi, mondok nanggon inimbita dugwit, naninis ane yagan lagya neyalok, avakwa nin wisane enamwa o adumu andoma at enarigiluk, enamusek-enamusek lagya lagagis,” yiluk, yugeragagi.
Yugirigya lagagirik, “Anderogo ogarit lagyama, o ambi vaga it imam-imam enasini en, 'Anderogo ogwarup o,' yiluk, lakbanunggu lagagwama, o Ndamasik sup vaga lagya dugwit,
dingga naswei ninim lagusim, mbogot-vaga en abinak yevedogo nit nenadema wambu wagagi. Mo il abya andi horok maduk, nasin. Eke, andi ogagagi ako andi, abya mondok eve iya erogo higya lagagirik,

nit ovok wen vaga ndun yugu lagagumu, Iberani enane vaga yuknugu dugwit, ‘Saulus wai. Saulus wai. Hat nggarogo yiluk an anggin-mbanggin erogo nasiga? Hat ninim ogorek dogosogon halok, hat hivis hilup arisogon atma, hat nggarogo yiluk anderogo ogarit landiga yi?’ yiluk, iris naruk hunggu lagagirik,
‘Ai, Nasin. Hat sa o?’ Yugugu lagagimu, ‘Dek o. Haren anggin-mbanggin erogo narit landiga ako An Yesus aro.
Hat nayeloman akluk, yogak ogagya neyagen inim, hivis ogarit lagya dogop yukhirisogon ako inim, wene andi menda yugeregek lagya dogop denogo bagagiluk, yukhiri wagima, mendek iru.
It ap Yakuri inim, it weram Yakuri dek menda inim, enadema lakbagamima, iren andoma weyak okbagagu-selok, hagap wendatya dogosogon.

It o hup ovagak agarwik ako, inil venggenogo bisiluk, awiyama nunggu wagwi, eke, at ibilis avema bogogirikmu en wulukluk, Ala avema nunggu wagwi, ogarusogom, yumwak yiluk, lakbagasogon. It ako enendawi novaga vanggabaluk avyarat numbutwi-selok, enomaluk Ala en dek erogo bisiluk, at aburi denogo bogogirikmu inim lobalogo bisamwak yiluk, lakbagasogon,’ yiluk, yuknogogi,” yugeragagi.
Paulus ogagya lagagi mbilinogo yugeragagi wene
Yugirigya lagagirik, ambi inim yugirigya dugwit, Nasin Agiripa. Mbogot vaga en an nogo heda nabi heda yuknugu sigam hagagis ako, an ogagetek agirik andi dek.

Yuknogogi ako endak erogo it o Ndamasik agarwik ako yugirigya, o Yerusalem agarwik ako yugirigya, andi okbaluk, o Yudeya avilis ambot inim, it weram Yakuri dek menda inim, yugeregek lagya, ogagya dugwit, Hit ovok henendawi wenggebaluk, henomaluk vagalogo mbo bagu dogones. Eke, henomaluk mbo baluk, Ala musek lagwi avyarat henombarupwak yiluk, yi ogagek ndi ogagek eyave adigat ogarit lagu dogones, yiluk, yugirigya lagagis.
“Anderogo yugeregek lagya lagagis andi vaga it Yakuri en Ala awi valekma andoma vakbaniluk, naruguluk ogagagwa menda,

o endak en yogak hudi, Ala en yonggatnita hegek niluk dugwit, it ap ininis werek inim, ininis dek inim, yugeraliga. Yugeraliga andi, wene adik menda ambi yugeregetek. Ata, ap Ala en yugirigya hegek yugurugu lagagwa navi-navi ako inim, at Musa inim, 'Anderogo ogarisogon o,' yiluk, avok yugurugu lagagwa wene ako vagalogo yugeraliga.
At Ala en denogo mekbagagi Keretus ako, nit Yakuri menda inim, it weram Yakuri dek menda inim, o awiya erogo bugu dogogiluk,
yagan warogo hambigya dogomindik, hambuluk lendagwima en endak iluk akluk mendok yisogon o, yiluk, yugu lagagwa ako yugeraliga,” yiluk, yugeragagi.
Paulus en wene andi ao yugirigya hegek, at Vetus ako ane ombok vaga iri dugwit, “Paulus wai. Hat nenek heyagi! Yi wene ndi wene mamulhedegek lagya vaga nenek hak yagan lagya heyagi.”
Yugugu lagagimu, Paulus en, “Hinis mondok siyalek agindik nasin Vetus wai. An nenek dek o. An nendawi sek en avyarat yukhisiga.

Nasin Agiripa wai. An wene yugeraliga andi, mbauk hwilago yugirigya lagibuk o. Wene an yugeraliga ako andi, hat nasin Agiripa ogo, hinggut andi dek, mondok helup imbiti. Wene andi ovok helupma, nalon dek dugwit, yukhisiga.
Nenasin Agiripa. It ap navi-navi Ala en yugirigya hegek yugurugu lagagwa wene ako, hat avyarat ombasiga a, dek a? Avyarat ombasiga an nelup.”
Yugugu lagagimu, at Agiripa en Paulus yugugu dugwit, “O yogak yi vaga at un mbikit an ap Kerisen menda okbanup embeten?”

Yugugu lagagimu, at Paulus en, “Nasin o. Hat hadigat wanok yiluk yukhisigadek. Hat inim, it yogak hulisagwi ovok inim, an heda maknetao hak makinivup dek ovara, an Keretus wene wagagis hak, yogak waup halok, yogak at wugwi, eke, hivis waup halok, hivis at wugwi, ogarovovok yiluk, an henake Ala yugisiga,” yiluk, yugogogi.
Yugugu lagagimu, enasin inis ombok ako inim, enasin gubernur ako inim, hwa Mberenike inim, it avakwa horaik welagagwa ako inim, ovok mendok yiluk,
wunggu lagagwarik, “Weyak ogaguselok, heda marogo mabiselagwima mabugwis, initwis, ogasagwi menda anderogo ambi ogagetek higyo,” yiluk, ambi yugigik ogagu lagagwarik,
at Agiripa en Vetus ako yugugu dugwit, “At ap andi, nasin Kaisar nawene amburup mbalupwak o, yilipuk en, yogak heda mago agarik ako visilogo balip,” yiluk, yugogogi.

footnotes.text: Inis Raja adem andi, ap ombok negara ambi vagago welagagi halok, inis Raja yugu lagagwa. Ap Agiripa ako andi negara maduk ambi o Palestina akoma vagago welagagi.

Adem ap akwa awiya erogo bisaup ako andi, Ala wene vaga nit Ala endawi ombasiga menda inim, Ala en nenagap wendarisiga inim, Yesus avyarat umbutu niniselok mondok-mondok niniluk dogop inim, ninilup asagwi. Lakbogogi Wene 13:47 yokanes.
